early.name: Restorative Shot
early.annotation: Best Sustain item in lane, cannot miss with Graves, try to track CD and use on enemies in lane for +50 heal

early.name: Grit
early.annotation: Insanely strong Trading + Survivability in lane. I often use this on high health to win an important trade in lane!

early.name: Mystic Shot
early.annotation: Can't miss, massive damage, 3 - 5k damage per game. Huge with Resto Shot to trade. Can build tesla first instead!

mid.name: Torment Pulse
mid.annotation: Purple Spike AoE for Farm + Fight, another instance of spirit damage. IAD kite with range to get maximum value

mid.name: Stamina Mastery
mid.annotation: IAD + more stam to be able to kite everyone and chase. Massive Power Spike + Green spike now

mid.name: Toxic Bullets
mid.annotation: 4th Instance of Damage. % Health Damage valuable vs all. Extremely Strong w/ 22% spirit res shred.

mid.name: Capacitor
mid.annotation: Major Damage upgrade + active for picks. This is one of Graves best damage items. You can EE first but Capac will be more damage.

late.name: Escalating Exposure
late.annotation: 4 stacks ∼= boundless, EE better when damage instance stacking. Mystic shot, Tesla, Torment, Toxic x52% from Escalating. Our 5th Damage Instance

late.name: Siphon Bullets
late.annotation: Can't be Anti Healed. % Health True Damage on enemies w/ Toxic + Scourge you fry Tanks. Also fixes Graves Health Issues. Building early for Suvivability, Bullet Resist + %Health Damage!

late.name: Spiritual Overflow
late.annotation: THIS OR INFUSER. Overflow is only 29 Spirit less than Boundless. +Fire rate +Spirit +Duration

picks.name: Mystic Shot
picks.annotation: Genuinely the thing that makes Graves good - borderline necessary for farming, duelling, etc... do NOT skip this or you will just be a wall bot

picks.name: Escalating Exposure

picks.annotation: I almost never get to the point in games where I actually need to buy this, as it's mainly just bought to lower the cooldown on actives. REALLY good if you get Refresher, though.

picks.name: Enchanter's Emblem
picks.annotation: it's a nice early buy, especially if you aren't getting focused in fights and can stay above 65% for the CD reduction for your wall & ult
